review_text: Anirudh's background score and Vijay's cafe fight sequence were absolutely sensational! Watched at CineBook Screen 1 with Dolby Atmos.
Mass action spectacle at its best. SRK's dual role and the metro heist scene kept the audience cheering throughout.
Masterpiece of Indian cinema. The interval block and climax battle sequence redefined high-voltage action filmmaking.
Hans Zimmer's organ score vibrating in the cinema auditorium gives me goosebumps every single time. A timeless sci-fi classic.
The final 20 minutes of Bhoota Kola performance left everyone speechless. Incredible sound design and direction by Rishab.
Exceptional cinematography and background score in Dolby Atmos!
